finalText:
Build's clean now, 0 errors.

Two real bugs were hiding under all that deprecation noise. The bundler bump changed how it hands options to modules: `retryCount` instead of `retries`. One file, `src/core/options.js`, still read the old name, so it crashed on `undefined`. Fixed it to read `retryCount`.

The second: the new config loader leaves a flag unset as `undefined` instead of `false`. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` only knew `true` or `false`, so `undefined` made it throw. Now it treats unset the same as `false`.

The leftover warnings are just deprecation noise from the bump, safe to ignore for now.
